manifest.configuration_1: Install managed Tectonic from the app or put tectonic or pdflatex on PATH, then create a paper or clone a repository with non-interactive Git credentials already configured.
manifest.description: A LaTeX paper editor with live PDF preview and an AI co-author. Write in a split-pane editor, press Cmd+S (Ctrl+S on Windows and Linux) to compile with pdflatex or tectonic, and read the rendered PDF beside your source. Compilation errors are parsed into a clickable list that jumps to the offending line. Clone an existing paper from any git remote, then commit and push from the toolbar. The co-author panel is a real Kiro Crew chat session scoped to the paper, so the agent can read and edit your LaTeX while you watch the PDF update.
manifest.highlight_1: Split-pane LaTeX editor with a live PDF preview beside it
manifest.highlight_2: Compile on save (Cmd+S, or Ctrl+S on Windows and Linux) via pdflatex or tectonic, with the bibtex cycle run for you
manifest.highlight_3: No TeX installed? One click installs a verified Tectonic compiler into Papyrus’s own folder
manifest.highlight_4: Compiler errors and warnings parsed into a clickable list that jumps to the line
manifest.highlight_5: AI co-author chat scoped to the paper — it reads and edits the LaTeX you are looking at
manifest.highlight_6: Clone a paper from any git remote, then commit, pull, and push from the toolbar
manifest.highlight_7: Never runs the compiler with shell escape, so a hostile .tex file cannot execute commands
manifest.use_case_1: Write a LaTeX paper beside its compiled PDF, jump from build errors to source, and collaborate with a paper-scoped agent.

page.compiler_tip: The LaTeX compiler found on the machine running {{productName}}. Papyrus prefers pdflatex and falls back to tectonic.

page.invalid_project_name: Paper names become folder names, so they can use only lowercase Latin letters (a–z), digits (0–9), dots, hyphens and underscores, must start with a letter or digit, and can be at most 64 characters.
page.invalid_project_name_char: “{{char}}” can’t be used in a paper name. Use lowercase a–z, 0–9, . -⁠ _
page.invalid_project_name_letter: “{{char}}” ({{script}}, {{code}}) can’t be used in a paper name. Use lowercase a–z, 0–9, . -⁠ _
page.latex_papers_with_a_live_pdf_preview: LaTeX papers with a live PDF preview
page.no_compiler_found_install_texlive_or_tec: No LaTeX compiler was found on this machine. Install TeX Live (pdflatex) or tectonic to compile.
page.no_compiler_install_bundled_prompt: No LaTeX compiler was found on this machine. Install the bundled Tectonic compiler — a single verified download, kept inside Papyrus's own folder.
page.rename_config_refused: The name wasn’t saved: Papyrus can’t change this paper’s settings.
page.rename_paper_replaced: This paper changed since the list loaded. The list is up to date now; press Enter to save the name again.
page.rename_title_rejected: Type a name with visible characters, or clear the field to show {{name}} again.
page.start_a_paper_tip: Create an empty paper from a standard article template, or clone one from a git remote — anything with a .tex file works.
